subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: Pseudonymity and Free Speech
description: A micro-lesson that makes Pseudonymity and Free Speech usable.

hook.text: The Federalist Papers were published under a fake name. Pseudonymity has a long tradition in democracy.

buildup.text: Pseudonyms let people speak freely without risking retaliation from employers, governments, or mobs.

discovery.text: Whistleblowers, dissidents, and abuse survivors rely on pseudonyms to share truth safely online.

twist.text: Platforms have pushed 'real name' policies, arguing they reduce abuse. But they also silence the vulnerable.

climax.text: Real-name policies protect civility. Pseudonymity protects the people who need protection most.

punchline.text: Real names for civility. Fake names for survival.

quiz.question: Why is pseudonymity important for free speech?
options: It protects speakers from retaliation by employers, governments, and mobs
It makes online discussions more polite
It increases advertising revenue for platforms
